resources.string: A little light for your home screen. Connect your player to see artwork and control playback.
You’re connected. Add the widget, then play something in your favorite media app.

Android notification access can read notifications. Music Widget uses media information to show and control playback and reopen your player. It does not save notification messages or send media data to the developer. Review the Privacy policy below before enabling access.
Open App remembers your last player.
Install a media app, then choose it here.
Long-press your home screen, open Widgets, then add Media Widget.
Confirm the widget placement on your home screen.
